summary: Stantec Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders. The filing is a routine report of shareholder meeting outcomes mandated by Canadian continuous disclosure rules, equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.07. It includes director elections, auditor reappointment, and an advisory vote on executive compensation—all standard agenda items. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or management change. The filing is purely informational and procedural.
